note: All residential electricity (heating, hot water, cooking, appliances, cooling, others). PyPSA subtracts the electric space/water heating itself (build_heat_demand), so the heating share must stay in here.
Final energy incl. district heat (Eurostat/JRC-IDEES boundary used by PyPSA). incl-district-heating = bld_energy-demand (incl. ambient) + district heat, see patex docs/model/buildings.md.
Remove ambient heat captured by heat pumps: not final energy, PyPSA models it through the COP.
Non-electric space/water heating is taken from bld_energy-demand-incl-district-heating (total ... space/water).

Agriculture rows: category = carrier group, split into total agriculture electricity/heat/machinery with data/agriculture_use_shares.csv (JRC-IDEES base-year shares, see patex_pypsa/agriculture.py).
liquid-bio comes from PatEx fossil-to-bio switches, mostly of diesel: split like diesel (IDEES: diesel oil and liquid biofuels).
PatEx gasoline + oil = IDEES 'Fuel oil and other liquids' in the base year, which IDEES uses for heat only.
PatEx includes LPG in gaseous-ff-natural.
Not a PyPSA-Eur column: fuel-cell road vehicles (patex_pypsa.transport).
Not a PyPSA-Eur column: gas road vehicles, a load on the gas bus with CO2 (ICE profile). PyPSA decides the gas origin.
Own load (rail electricity), not in the base load.
Not a PyPSA-Eur column: load on the H2 bus (flat).
Not a PyPSA-Eur column: own load (aviation electricity), domestic + bunkers.
Not a PyPSA-Eur column: own load (shipping electricity), IWW + bunkers.
Not a PyPSA-Eur column: hydrogen share of navigation per country (add_shipping); the rest of total navigation is oil. PatEx has no methanol or ammonia ships (Q14).
Electric aviation: electricity aviation (PyPSA-Eur serves aviation as kerosene).
Inland waterways, electric part in electricity navigation. Domestic maritime in IWW or bunkers-marine: Q5.
Gas burnt (CO2 counted by PyPSA). PyPSA decides the gas origin (fossil/bio/syn); PatEx carrier split is not imposed.
Not a PyPSA-Eur column: feedstock gas (ammonia, olefins), a gas load without CO2 in PyPSA. The CO2 it releases is in PatEx process emissions.
Includes feedstock hydrogen (ammonia, ...). PyPSA-Eur also has an `ammonia` column: avoid counting the ammonia route twice.
PyPSA-Eur splits coal and coke; PatEx has a single solid-ff-coal carrier. Coke column is set to 0 when industry is soft-linked.
Liquid feedstock (olefins, other non-energy uses): the PyPSA-Eur plastics (HVC) chain. PyPSA decides the oil origin.
Not a PyPSA-Eur column: liquids burnt in industry (steam cracker fuel, other uses), an oil load with combustion CO2 (T24). PyPSA decides the oil origin.
Fuel in kilns (cement, ceramics, lime). No such carrier in PyPSA-Eur: not supplied by the network, only its CO2 (x PatEx ind-combustion-emission-factor) is added to process emission at export.

Not a PyPSA-Eur column: target for the residual hourly electricity load once PyPSA has removed electric heating and today's industry electricity (appliances, lighting, cooling, cooking). Used to rescale n.loads_t.p_set per country at the end of prepare_sector_network.
Electric space/water heating is served from PyPSA heat buses.
Process emissions before capture (PyPSA decides capture). CO2e: small non-CO2 share. Ammonia includes the CO2 of its feedstock gas, see methane feedstock.
Steam cracker CO2: in PyPSA-Eur a split of the naphtha carbon (process vs end of life), not added on top.
PyPSA-Eur computes combustion CO2 from the fuels it supplies.
Turned into district heat share = district heat / (total residential + services space + water) at export, same final-energy base as the heat totals.
Cars and vans with a plug (PHEV once, under its fuel carrier). Sizes EV chargers, smart charging and V2G (PyPSA-Eur car-type battery).
